# Section ready bits

Set after the decoder completes and the section's constructors run; what native section_wait reads.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0xa26e2694` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

The finaliser 0x600464d0 sets these; 0x6004637c, called by section_wait, reads them.
